The basic pay for SSC GD Constables is generally in the pay band of ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 (Level 3 in the 7th Pay Commission).
There is no separate grade pay in the 7th Pay Commission structure; instead, the salary is consolidated into the basic pay and other allowances.
Dearness Allowance (DA): This is a cost of living adjustment allowance, which is a percentage of the basic pay and is revised periodically.

House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is provided based on the posting location. The percentage varies by city category:
																	
																		X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
																		Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
																		Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
X-Class Cities: 24% of basic pay.
Y-Class Cities: 16% of basic pay.
Z-Class Cities: 8% of basic pay.
Other Allowances: May include medical allowances, travel allowances, and uniform allowances, among others, depending on the posting and duties.

The gross salary is the sum of the basic pay, DA, HRA, and any other allowances. For a GD Constable, this can typically range between ₹25,000 to ₹35,000 per month, depending on the location and other factors.
Deductions may include Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and income tax as applicable.
Promotion Opportunities: SSC GD Constables can be promoted to higher ranks based on performance and seniority.
Pension: Eligible for a pension scheme as per government regulations.
Medical Benefits: Medical facilities and allowances are often provided.
Leave Entitlements: Includes earned leave, casual leave, and other types of leave.
